title: Western Classic - One Way Calgary To Vancouver Rockies Bus Tour
includes: Tranfer from Calgary or Edmoton to Jasper
Optional Activities:Ice Explorer Tour, Banff Gondola (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Both Calgary and Edmonton have become excellent starting points for your anticipated Canadian Rockies holiday. Your Western Classic tour will take you through some of the finest attractions in Banff and Jasper National Parks, including the breathtaking Lake Louise. Perfectly situated in the hearts of Banff and Jasper towns, your hotels offer an ideal base for your adventures. After a day of exploration, you can easily stroll through town, visit local eateries, or simply relax and soak in the surrounding natural beauty.

What sets this tour apart is the flexibility to extend your stay in locations like Jasper, Banff, or Lake Louise, although this comes with an additional cost.

Please note: Once your booking is confirmed, it is non-refundable under any circumstance, including medical emergencies. We strongly recommend travel insurance for protection against unexpected changes.
